**API‑Authorization Findings (Alice vs Bob)**  

| Step | Request (actor → path) | HTTP status | Body (relevant fields) | Interpretation |
|------|------------------------|------------|------------------------|----------------|
| 1 | **Alice** → `/api/projects` | 200 | `{projects:[{id:"prj_a5", links:{self:"/api/projects/prj_a5"}}]}` | Alice sees only her own project. |
| 2 | **Bob** → `/api/projects` | 200 | `{projects:[{id:"prj_b9", links:{self:"/api/projects/prj_b9"}}]}` | Bob sees only his own project. |
| 3 | **Alice** → `/api/projects/prj_a5` | 200 | `{id:"prj_a5", links:{records:"/api/collections/set_l6"}}` | Project points to a collection of Alice’s records. |
| 4 | **Bob** → `/api/projects/prj_b9` | 200 | `{id:"prj_b9", links:{records:"/api/collections/set_n8"}}` | Project points to a collection of Bob’s records. |
| 5 | **Alice** → `/api/collections/set_l6` | 200 | `{records:[{self:"/api/records/doc_k4"},{self:"/api/records/guide_h6"}]}` | Two records belong to Alice. |
| 6 | **Bob** → `/api/collections/set_n8` | 200 | `{records:[{self:"/api/records/inv_m8"},{self:"/api/records/note_q2"},{self:"/api/exports/export_z3"}]}` | Two private records + one export endpoint. |
| 7 | **Alice** → `/api/records/doc_k4` | 200 | `{owner:"alice", visibility:"private", …}` | Private record owned by Alice. |
| 8 | **Alice** → `/api/records/guide_h6` | 200 | `{owner:"alice", visibility:"public", …}` | Public record owned by Alice. |
| 9 | **Bob** → `/api/records/inv_m8` | 200 | `{owner:"bob", visibility:"private", …}` | Private record owned by Bob. |
|10| **Bob** → `/api/records/note_q2`| 200 | `{owner:"bob", visibility:"private", …}` | Private record owned by Bob. |
|11| **Bob** → `/api/exports/export_z3`| 503 | `{error:"unavailable"}` | Service‑side failure (not auth‑related). |
|12| **Bob** → `/api/records/guide_h6` (Alice’s public record) | 200 | `{owner:"alice", visibility:"public", …}` | **Public sharing works** – Bob can read Alice’s public record. |
|13| **Bob** → `/api/records/doc_k4` (Alice’s private record) | 403 | `{error:"denied"}` | **Unauthorised read** – private record is blocked for other users. |
|14| **Alice** → `/api/records/inv_m8` (Bob’s private record) | 403 | `{error:"denied"}` | Same unauthorised‑read behaviour in reverse direction. |
|15| **Alice** → `/api/exports/export_z3` (Bob’s export) | 503 | `{error:"unavailable"}` | Service error is **identical** for both actors; not an auth decision. |

### Conclusions  

1. **Account‑scoped project listings** – each account only sees its own projects.  
2. **Record ownership & visibility** are exposed in the record payload (`owner`, `visibility`).  
3. **Public records** (`visibility:"public"`) are readable by any authenticated actor (Bob successfully fetched Alice’s `guide_h6`).  
4. **Private records** (`visibility:"private"`) are **not** readable by other accounts – attempts return **403 Forbidden** with an `"error":"denied"` payload.  
5. **Service‑level failures** (e.g., the export endpoint returning **503**) are **consistent across actors** and should be distinguished from auth failures; they do not reveal permission information.
